integrity: The finite domain is exhaustively enumerated with duplicate implementations of both mechanisms, independent Pareto-efficiency enumeration over every perfect matching, and a separate Burnside reconstruction of the symmetry quotient.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is exhaustive only for strict unit-capacity school-choice markets through three students and three schools. It does not assert a larger-market frequency formula. An earlier directly related working paper is dated February 2004 without a day in the inspected copy; no day is imputed.
title: Exact three-by-three divergence census for deferred acceptance and top trading cycles
